observation: The complete exercise history mixes shared drawing invariants with addition- and extraction-specific transformations, and historical examples can be mistaken for newly verified universal rules.
cause: Lessons accumulated across separate corrections and companion-skill exercises without one classification and routing summary.
proposed_rule: Keep evidence, geometry, dimensions, presentation, and acceptance in the main drawing skill; route insertion and standalone extraction to their companion skills; classify verified rules, owner preferences, project examples, and limitations separately.
verification_scope: Instruction routing, package validation, source-review separation, and recorded A200 exercise regressions; no unseen-drawing performance claim.
